cart.personalised_label: Personalized — we’ll print from your mockup

delivery.returns_eu: EU and UK customers have a statutory cooling-off period for unused goods. Personalized items made to order may have limited return rights — see our refund policy.
delivery.returns_generic: Personalized photo products are made to order. See our refund policy for returns and reprints.

chooser.fallback: Open the canvas product to choose size and personalize.
chooser.cta_note: Next: personalize with your photo on the product page.

collection.mugs_lead: Ceramic, enamel, porcelain, magic and travel mugs — pick a style, then personalize with your photo.
collection.phone_cases_lead: Flexi, slim, clear, bio and tough cases for Apple and Samsung — pick a style and model, then personalize.
collection.totes_lead: Classic and premium personalized totes — pick a color, then add your photo or design.
collection.wall_art_lead: Canvas, framed prints, metal, acrylic, posters and more — pick a product type to personalize.
collection.home_gifts_lead: Personalized mugs, bottles, phone cases, tote bags, stickers, tattoos and more — everyday keepsakes they’ll actually use.
collection.posters_lead: Pick a paper finish. Next you’ll choose size and personalize with your photo.
collection.framed_prints_lead: Wooden or metal frames — pick a finish, then choose size, color and assembly where available.
collection.aluminum_lead: Sleek aluminum panels — choose a finish, then orientation and size.
collection.foam_lead: Lightweight foam board — portrait, landscape or square, with optional edge color.

product_page.customise_body: Use Personalize to upload your photo, preview on a live mockup, then add to cart. We print and ship to your door.
product_page.frame_colours_body: White, wood, dark wood or black — match your room and let the print take center stage.
product_page.personalize_hint: Add to cart and Personalize both open the designer — upload your photo, then it goes in the cart.
product_page.pdp_lead_brushed: A frameless aluminum panel with a brushed metallic grain. About 3 mm thick, with magnetic mounts included.
product_page.pdp_lead_fine_art: Archival 200 gsm matte, printed 12-color giclée. A gallery sheet to frame yourself.
product_page.pdp_lead_classic_framed: Classic semi-gloss paper in a slim wood frame, four colors, sawtooth hanger included.
product_page.pdp_lead_premium_framed: Premium semi-gloss paper in a slim wood frame, four colors, ready to hang.
product_page.pdp_lead_fine_art_framed: Archival giclée in a slim wood frame. Gallery paper, four frame colors, sawtooth hanger included.
product_page.subtitle_hanger: Poster with hanger — pick hanger color, orientation and size
product_page.subtitle_framed_canvas: Canvas in a tray frame — pick frame color, orientation and size
product_page.subtitle_wooden_framed: Wooden framed print — pick frame color, orientation and size
product_page.story_sizes_body: Thirteen sizes in portrait, landscape and square — from 20×25 cm (8×10″) up to 60×90 cm (24×36″). Pick what fits the space, then personalize with your photo.
product_page.story_colours_body: Natural wood, dark wood and matte black. Match the room and let the photo take center stage.
product_page.story_texture_body: Cotton-polyester blend on FSC stretcher bars, printed for lasting color. A hanging kit is included — thickness is 42 mm in North America and 32 mm in Europe.
product_page.canvas_story_texture_body: Cotton-polyester blend stretched over FSC wood bars, printed for lasting color. The weave is part of the finish — not a flat poster.
product_page.canvas_story_hanging_body: Stapled on the back, with sawtooth hangers, hooks, screws and stretcher keys in the box. Personalize with your photo, then hang it.
product_page.aluminum_story_panel_body: Your photo prints onto a rigid aluminum composite panel — no frame, no glass. A slim modern edge that sits close to the wall.
product_page.aluminum_story_panel_alt: Angled aluminum print on a black background showing the thin panel edge
product_page.aluminum_story_edge_body: A sleek white-core sandwich around 3 mm thick, with vivid color on a smooth metal face. Built to last indoors.
product_page.aluminum_story_lifestyle_body: Leans or hangs as a clean panel. Personalize with your photo, pick orientation and size, and it is ready for the room.
product_page.brushed_story_stack_body: A rigid aluminum sandwich around 3 mm thick — metal skins, dark core, sharp square corners. No frame, no glass. Portraits, couples and stills all sit on that brushed face.
product_page.brushed_story_stack_alt: Three brushed aluminum prints stacked on a white surface showing the thin sandwich edge
product_page.brushed_story_edge_alt: Magnified corner of a brushed aluminum print showing surface grain and sandwich edge
product_page.brushed_story_lean_body: The grain becomes part of the picture. Lean it or hang it as a clean panel — personalize with your photo, pick orientation and size, and it is ready for the room.
product_page.brushed_story_lean_alt: Brushed aluminum print leaning against a wall on a wooden floor
product_page.brushed_story_room_alt: Two brushed aluminum prints on a wall above a console table
product_page.hanger_story_wood_body: Two matching wooden bars sandwich the poster. Light oak grain, a slim leather-look cord, and magnets that grip the paper without clips or tape. Pick hanger color in the options above.
product_page.hanger_story_paper_body: Heavy 200 gsm / 80 lb stock with a fine pebbled grain and no glare. Colors sit soft and gallery-flat — made for indoor walls.
product_page.hanger_story_lifestyle_body: Hangs as a clean vertical panel above a console or sofa. Personalize with your photo, pick orientation, size and hanger color, and it is ready for the room.
product_page.wood_story_layers_body: Around 10–15 mm of stacked birch plies. The magnified corner shows a clean cut and the wood grain under the color — sturdy, warp-resistant and made for indoor walls.
product_page.wood_story_pair_body: Two boards side by side, same thickness and the same warm timber showing through. Personalize with your photos, pick orientation and size, and they sit as a set.
product_page.poster_story_look_body: A slim, frameless print with a soft semi-gloss sheen. Colors stay vivid, edges stay sharp — hang it, frame it, or pin it as a clean sheet of art.
product_page.poster_story_paper_body: Mid-weight 170 gsm / 65 lb stock with a fine grain and a low sheen — not matte, not high-gloss. Colors sit bright without a harsh mirror shine.
product_page.poster_story_finish_body: The everyday gallery finish: saturated color, a gentle highlight down the sheet, and a smooth face that photographs and rooms well.
product_page.poster_story_finish_alt: Classic semi-glossy paper sample with abstract color and finish label
product_page.poster_story_gallery_body: Personalize with your photo, pick orientation and size, then hang a single sheet or frame a set. Same paper, same sheen — they read as a collection.
product_page.matte_poster_story_look_body: A slim, frameless sheet with a fine pebbled grain and no glare. Soft color, museum-flat — hang it, frame it, or pin it as a quiet piece of art.
product_page.matte_poster_story_paper_body: Heavy 200 gsm / 80 lb stock with a toothy, non-reflective face. Colors sit soft and gallery-flat — made for indoor walls and wooden frames.
product_page.matte_poster_story_finish_alt: Premium matte paper sample with abstract color and finish label
product_page.matte_poster_story_room_body: Personalize with your photo, pick orientation and size, then hang the sheet or drop it into a thin wood frame. Matte paper does not bounce the room back at you.
product_page.fine_art_story_look_body: A heavy, textured fine-art sheet with a generous white margin. No frame, no glass — just archival paper and color that is meant to last.
product_page.fine_art_story_border_alt: Fine art poster with a painterly color grid and a wide white border
product_page.fine_art_story_paper_body: Heavy 200 gsm / 80 lb stock with a fine, fibrous grain. Matte, not glossy — the kind of paper watercolor and giclée prints are made for.
product_page.fine_art_story_giclee_body: Standard inkjet uses four inks. Fine art giclée uses twelve — smoother gradients, deeper blues, richer oranges. The difference is in the color, not just the paper.
product_page.fine_art_story_giclee_alt: Side-by-side comparison of 4-color inkjet and 12-color fine art giclée
product_page.fine_art_story_detail_body: Soft, toothy paper that drinks pigment without glare. Personalize with your photo, pick orientation and size, then hang or frame it as a true print.
product_page.classic_framed_story_colours_body: The same slim mitered profile in four finishes. Match the room, keep the print center stage. Pick frame color in the options above.
product_page.classic_framed_story_room_body: Personalize with your photo, pick orientation, size and frame color. Hangs as a clean square or rectangle above a chair or side table.
product_page.classic_framed_story_room_alt: Framed semi-glossy poster hanging on a gray wall above a wooden side table
product_page.premium_framed_story_colours_body: The same slim mitered profile in four finishes. Match the room, keep the print center stage. Pick frame color in the options above.
product_page.premium_framed_story_room_body: Personalize with your photo, pick orientation, size and frame color. Hangs as a clean square or rectangle above a chair or coffee table.
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_look_body: Your photo prints as a giclée on archival paper, then sits in a thin wooden frame behind glass. Gallery color, a museum sheet, ready to hang.
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_colours_body: The same slim mitered profile in four finishes. Match the room, keep the print center stage. Pick frame color in the options above.
product_page.fine_art_framed_story_room_body: Personalize with your photos, pick orientation, size and frame color. Two prints side by side — the same fine art sheet, the same slim wood.
product_page.metal_framed_story_wall_body: Personalize with your photo, pick orientation and size. Hangs as a clean square or rectangle on a white wall — the black metal line is the only border.
product_page.metal_framed_story_room_body: The same slim metal works beside a chair or a lamp. Semi-gloss paper keeps color bright without a harsh mirror shine.
product_page.acrylic_story_stack_body: Color sits behind the acrylic so it looks deeper and brighter. Portraits, landscapes and stills all get that gallery-glass finish without a frame.
product_page.foam_story_pair_body: Two boards side by side above a table. Personalize with your photos, pick portrait, square or landscape on the matching product page, and they sit as a set.
product_page.foam_story_hold_body: Landscape boards are wide and still light. Personalize with your photo, pick the size, then hang it or hold it up to see how it fills the space.
